Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000719" [decision]: The Cinder team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-23, when ownership transferred from the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000715" [decision]: Ownership of the job scheduler transferred from the Dune team to the Cinder team on 2025-09-23.  (about: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000711": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000645": The Dune team observed on 2025-08-19 that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Dune team, resizer, runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000554" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000533" [decision]: The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000525" [decision]: The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, when ownership moved from the Ember team.  (about: Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000517": As of 2025-06-24, the reporting service still relies on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000480": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the handover doc for the billing API for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000430": As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000420": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000357" [decision]: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day as of 2025-04-21.  (about: Dune team, monthly game day)
- memory_id "1000354" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000334": The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, client rollout)
- memory_id "1000288": The Dune team owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Dune team, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher depends on the bus for outbound events, so it is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier depends on the bus for delivery events, so it is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000147": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000130": The reporting service is a Dune team service.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
Existing entity names: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team, resizer, runtime upgrade, Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team, notifier, ledger service, reporting service, Lena, Oskar, webhook dispatcher, monthly game day, the bus, client rollout, reports pipeline

The note:

[2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.

Better to keep entities as reporting service, ledger service. Actually "billing runs" is ambiguous; I'll avoid mapping to billing API.

1. Fact: "As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service." kind: decision, evidence: "Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source." entities: [reporting service, the bus, ledger service].

2. Fact: "The reporting service stopped using the ledger service because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs." kind: fact, evidence: "the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs". entities: [reporting service, ledger service].

Hmm, is the reason durable? It's a "why" stated in the note, which is durable context. I'll include it.

Actually, should I correct both 1000517 and 1000147? Both state the dependency. The note says "Reporting no longer depends on Ledger." Both facts are about the dependency. Yes, correct both.

I'll phrase: "The reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; as of 2025-09-23 it uses the bus as its source."
